{{Top|leg}}
The '''Moff{{'s}} Own''' was a legion of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] assigned to an individual [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]. The legion was under the explicit command of the Moff at all [[Time/Legends|times]].
